arxiv-2103-13038.title: Spin susceptibilities in magnetic type-I and type-II Weyl semimetals
arxiv-2103-13038.creator: Feng Xiong, Xingjie Han, Carsten Honerkamp
arxiv-2103-13038.description: Abstract We investigate interacting spin susceptibilities in lattice models for 𝒯 \mathcal{T} -reversal symmetry-broken Weyl semimetals. We employ a random phase approximation (RPA) method for the spin-SU(2)-symmetry-broken case that includes mixtures of ladder and bubble diagrams, beyond a SU(2)-symmetric case.

arxiv-2305-12437.title: SCP: Soft Conditional Prompt Learning for Aerial Video Action Recognition
arxiv-2305-12437.creator: Xijun Wang*, Ruiqi Xian*, Tianrui Guan, Fuxiao Liu, Dinesh Manocha
arxiv-2305-12437.description: Abstract We present a new learning approach, Soft Conditional Prompt Learning (SCP), which leverages the strengths of prompt learning for aerial video action recognition. Our approach is designed to predict the action of each agent by helping the models focus on the descriptions or instructions associated with actions in the input videos for aerial/robot visual perception.

arxiv-2307-08832.title: Resource Augmentation Analysis of the Greedy Algorithm for the Online Transportation Problem
arxiv-2307-08832.creator: Stephen Arndt, Josh Ascher, Kirk Pruhs
arxiv-2307-08832.description: Abstract We consider the online transportation problem set in a metric space containing parking garages of various capacities. Cars arrive over time, and must be assigned to an unfull parking garage upon their arrival. The objective is to minimize the aggregate distance that cars have to travel to their assigned parking garage.

arxiv-2509-19795.title: On the formation of star-forming galaxies having anomalously low-metallicity regions: the role of galaxy interaction and CGM/IGM accretion astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 ) , matplotlib ( Hunter 2007 )
arxiv-2509-19795.creator: Yibo Cao, Zhizheng Pan
arxiv-2509-19795.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yibo Cao, Zhizheng Pan. Gas accretion from both the circum-galactic medium (CGM)/inter-galatic medium (IGM) and interacting companion galaxy can dilute the gas phase metallicity of a galaxy. However, their relative contribution to the chemical evolution of galaxies remains to be quantified. To this end, in this work we study a sample of 510 star-forming galaxies (SFGs) having anomalously low-metallicity (ALM) regions selected from the MaNGA data available in the Data Release 17 from the Sloan Digital Sky Survey.

arxiv-2602-13595.title: The Quantization Trap: Breaking Linear Scaling Laws in Multi-Hop Reasoning
arxiv-2602-13595.creator: Henry Han, Xiyang Liu, Xiaodong Wang, Fei Han, Xiaodong Li
arxiv-2602-13595.description: Abstract Neural scaling laws provide a predictable recipe for AI advancement: reducing numerical precision should linearly improve computational efficiency and energy profile ( E ∝ bits E\propto\text{bits} ). In this paper, we demonstrate that this scaling law breaks in the context of multi-hop reasoning.

pmc-11351113.title: Eucalyptus Essential Oil Inhibits Cell Infection by SARS-CoV-2 Spike Pseudotyped Lentivirus
pmc-11351113.creator: Sara Alonso Fernandez, Hector F Pelaez-Prestel, Alvaro Ras-Carmona, Juan Mozas-Gutierrez, Raquel Reyes-Manzanas, Pedro A Reche, Toshihiro Kita
pmc-11351113.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) remains a public health concern due to infections with new SARS-CoV-2 variants. Therefore, finding effective preventive and therapeutic treatments against all SARS-CoV-2 variants is of great interest. In this study, we examined the capacity of eucalyptus essential oil (EEO) and eucalyptol (EOL) to prevent SARS-CoV-2 infection, using as a model SARS-CoV-2 Spike pseudotyped lentivirus (SARS-CoV-2 pseudovirus) and 293T cells transfected with human angiotensin-converting enzyme 2 (hACE2-293T cells).

pmc-12441819.title: Pd-catalyzed desulfonylative fluorination of electron-deficient (hetero)aryl sulfonyl fluorides
pmc-12441819.creator: Jonathan R. Hall, Natalie P. Romer, Taylor E. Spiller, Matthew S. Sigman, Melanie S. Sanford
pmc-12441819.description: A new C(sp2)–F bond forming reaction that eliminates the need for exogenous metal fluoride salts is reported. Pd catalysis is used to convert electron-deficient (hetero)aryl sulfonyl fluorides (ArSO2F) to the corresponding (hetero)aryl fluorides with extrusion of SO2. Data science methods are employed to assess substrate requirements and identify a non-intuitive class of phosphine ligands for this transformation.

pmc-12464708.title: Impact of Neighborhood Factors on Heart Failure Outcomes
pmc-12464708.creator: Timothy Bober, Emily N Guhl, Scott Rothenberger, Kwonho Jeong, Kaleab Z Abebe, Julia Holber, Amy M Anderson, Jared W Magnani, Amber E Johnson, Bruce L Rollman
pmc-12464708.description: BackgroundFew studies have examined the impact of neighborhood-level factors on outcomes for patients with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF).ObjectivesThe purpose of this study was to understand the impact of neighborhood factors on readmission and mortality risk hospitalized patients with HFrEF.

pmc-12485473.title: Analgesic effects of transversus abdominis plane and quadratus lumborum blocks are not clinically meaningful for laparoscopic nephrectomy: systematic review and network meta-analysis
pmc-12485473.creator: Boohwi Hong, Yumin Jo, Sujin Baek, Woosuk Chung, Chahyun Oh, Seyeon Park
pmc-12485473.description: BackgroundUltrasound-guided abdominal wall blocks are increasingly used to enhance postoperative analgesia in laparoscopic nephrectomy. Among these, the transversus abdominis plane (TAP) block and the quadratus lumborum (QL) block have emerged as promising techniques. However, no comprehensive review has yet compared the analgesic efficacy of these two regional approaches.

pmc-12764903.title: RAS/PI3K pathway mutations sensitise epithelial ovarian cancer cells to a PARP/NAMPT inhibitor combination
pmc-12764903.creator: Michael Gruet, Yitao Xu, Lyutong An, Yurui Ma, Cristina Balcells, Katie Tyson, Laila C. Evangelista, Sarah Spear, Yuewei Xu, Flora McKinney, Julia Babuta, Chandler Bray, Chiharu Wickremesinghe, Alexandros P. Siskos, Anke M. Nijhuis, Edward W. Tate, Iain A. McNeish, Adrian Benito, Hector C. Keun
pmc-12764903.description: The combination of PARP and NAMPT inhibitors (PARPi/NAMPTi) has been explored for the treatment of triple-negative breast cancer, Ewing sarcoma and high-grade serous carcinoma (HGSC). However, dose limiting toxicity has hampered NAMPTi in clinical trials. To maximise the therapeutic window, we set out to identify predictive genomic biomarkers.

pmc-13094409.title: Effect of Small Dense Low‐Density Lipoprotein Cholesterol Combined With High‐Sensitivity C‐Reactive Protein on Cardiometabolic Multimorbidity: A National Cohort Study
pmc-13094409.creator: Zi Guo, Jiaying Shen, Feng Song
pmc-13094409.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundSmall dense low‐density lipoprotein cholesterol (sdLDL‐C) is a more significant atherosclerotic factor than LDL‐C. This investigation aimed to examine the correlation between sdLDL‐C levels and the risk of cardiometabolic multimorbidity (CMM) in middle‐aged and older adults.MethodsParticipants aged ≥ 45 years who did not have CMM at baseline from the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study (CHARLS) data set were included in this cohort study. The baseline data of the participants were collected in 2011 and followed up until 2020.

pmc-13195669.title: GPR3 Ligands Discovered through Combined Virtual and Conformational Biosensor-Based Screening
pmc-13195669.creator: Hannes Schihada, Aida Shahraki, Ainoleena Turku-Metsänen, Maximilian Rath, Lukas Wirth, Katarina Nemec, Hrisowalantu Tselepli, Laura Heitzer, Bernadette Vallaster, Mariam Fadel, Gunnar Schulte, Daniel Hilger, Steffen Pockes, Martin J. Lohse, Peter Kolb
pmc-13195669.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). GPR3 belongs to the protein superfamily of G protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs) and plays a central role in both benign and malignant physiological processes, such as energy expenditure in adipocytes and Alzheimer’s disease pathology, respectively. Despite the therapeutic potential of both receptor agonists and inverse agonists, GPR3 so far has lacked drug-like ligands and innovative screening technologies, hindering effective drug discovery efforts targeting this receptor.
